metadata.title: A Table for Two Beginners — A2
metadata.synopsis: Duas pessoas se aproximam em uma aula de cerâmica e escolhem como transformar uma conversa desajeitada em um próximo encontro.

scenes.title: Two Unusual Bowls
scenes.narration: Rosa joined an evening pottery class after work. She chose a place beside a man in a blue apron. His bowl leaned to one side, and hers had a hole in the bottom. "Water can leave through that hole. Your bowl is ready for rain." "Then perhaps it is a flower pot." They laughed. The teacher asked everyone to leave their work to dry.

scenes.title: A Different Kind of Plan
scenes.narration: While they cleaned the table, Rosa found a small drawing on Eli's notebook. It showed a perfect round bowl. "That was the plan. Mine looks like a tired hat." Rosa showed him her own page. She had drawn a plant in a simple pot. "Perhaps we made the things we actually needed." Eli smiled and asked her name. They stayed to finish cleaning together.

scenes.title: Finding the Words
scenes.narration: Outside the studio, Eli told Rosa that he wanted to see her again. "I enjoyed the class much more with you." Rosa felt the same, but she needed a moment to find the words. She could invite him for a short walk by the canal, or ask him to share a table at the next class. "I would like that, too."

scenes.title: An Evening beyond the Studio
scenes.narration: Rosa asked Eli to walk beside the canal. He said yes. They talked about the things they hoped to make at the studio. At a small bridge, he stopped to watch the lights on the water. "Next time, I will bring a picture of my bowl." "Only if you let me bring my flower pot." They chose another evening to meet before they said goodbye.

scenes.title: The Seat beside Him
scenes.narration: Rosa asked Eli to share her table at the next class. A week later, he arrived early and saved the seat beside him. Their first bowls were dry on a shelf. "My flower pot needs a small plate under it." "And my tired hat needs a friend." They worked side by side, then made plans for coffee. This time, neither of them hurried home.
